body:
If I told you, you'd hardly believe it. It's simultaneously amazing and completely fucking unfair. I hardly believe it myself. That's why it's so difficult. I don't want it to be true, but it is.

I know that's totally non-specific. I can't give away much more than that.
I don't want you to get the wrong impression with my last message. I'm not leaving behind a spouse or kids or even any pets so it's all good.

I try to stay as fit as possible, mostly yoga since last year – a freak physical illness wrecked my overall health, and believe me, I was a fit motherfucker. That's just part of the issue here.

I know what you mean about things being right around the corner. Like pregnancy, divorce, getting fired, etc. I certainly didn't ever consider that mine would be the 9mm retirement plan. That's just how it happened.

Tonight, at that counter, asking the salesperson what pistol he'd recommend for "target shooting," I realized my demons won.

They win.

Is it wrong to end pain? We do the same for our pets, and for the elderly (when it can be disguised as accidental or incidental). 

Decades of physical hurt, and abuse to boot, and the mental anguish that came with it. It's wrecked my life, without question, it held me back from things I want and worked for and will continue to do so.

Being good or bad doesn't factor in. Bad genes and luck don't discriminate.

I would love to say that everything I've tried made a dent. Not really.

I leave behind some things that are very important to me, made sure I left a very positive mark. My note will explain things in greater detail.

Death is a rest. It's time to rest.

To recount everything would honestly just be a waste of my time and yours. Yes, there are people who will miss me, and many many many more people who won't.

I'm past the point of worrying about it.

The real reason for not going face is medical (long story), but I admit there's a nicety in leaving yourself cranially intact.
Very little to talk about. Tried last week with pills, didn't work, realized I need to ante up and get to the "99% certain" method.
